h1: Land Rover Diesel Timing Chain Repair
lede: Specialist timing chain replacement for TDV6, SDV6, TDV8 and SDV8 diesel engines. Fixed-price rebuilds with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

blocks.html: Replacing the timing chain and associated components on Land Rover TDV6, SDV6, TDV8 and SDV8 diesel engines. This is a precision engineering job that requires specialist tooling, JLR diagnostic equipment, and experience with Land Rover's V6 and V8 diesel architecture.

On TDV6/SDV6 engines, the timing drive uses a belt to drive the exhaust camshafts from the crankshaft, with small chains linking the exhaust and intake camshafts on each bank. This dual system means both belt and chain components must be correctly timed relative to each other - a job that demands precision and the correct locking tools.

TDV8/SDV8 engines follow a similar principle but with additional complexity due to the V8 configuration: two banks of cylinders, each with its own timing chain arrangement, requiring specific V8 timing tooling and more extensive front-end disassembly.

items: Replacement of all timing chains, tensioners, and guide rails
New camshaft sprockets and crankshaft pulley bolt where required
Full set of gaskets and seals (timing cover, crankshaft seal, camshaft seals)
Diagnostic timing check and road test

steps.title: Inspection & Diagnosis
steps.body: We begin with a thorough engine inspection to confirm the timing chain is the root cause. Our diagnostic equipment reads live data, checks for timing correlation faults, and identifies any associated wear.

steps.title: Vehicle Preparation
steps.body: We position the vehicle on a lift, remove the bonnet for access, and drain the engine oil and coolant. Front-end components - radiator, cooling fan, fan shroud, hoses - are carefully removed to expose the timing cover.

steps.title: Timing Cover Removal
steps.body: The front timing cover is removed to expose the timing chain drive. This requires careful handling to avoid damaging gasket surfaces.

steps.title: Chain & Component Removal
steps.body: We release the tensioners, remove the guide rails, and take out the old timing chains. Camshaft sprockets/phasers are removed where necessary. For TDV6/SDV6, we also remove the timing belt that drives the exhaust camshafts.

steps.title: Installation of New Components
steps.body: New timing chains are installed on the crankshaft drive sprocket and camshaft sprockets. New guide rails and tensioners are fitted. The timing is set precisely using manufacturer locking tools.

steps.title: Reassembly & Testing
steps.body: All new seals and gaskets are fitted. The front-end is reassembled, and fresh oil and coolant are added. We start the engine, check timing with diagnostics, and perform a full road test to verify the repair.

blocks.html: We have over a decade of experience rebuilding Land Rover diesel engines. Our workshop is equipped with JLR diagnostic tools, specialist timing locking kits, and a dedicated machine shop. Every repair includes a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

items.q: How much does a TDV6/SDV6 timing chain repair cost at Land Rover Garage?
items.a: TDV6/SDV6 timing chain repair starts from £2,400. TDV8/SDV8 starts from £4,500. Every rebuild includes new timing chains, tensioners, guides, gaskets, seals, oil and filter, and a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

items.q: How long does a Land Rover diesel timing chain repair take?
items.a: Most timing chain repairs are completed within 3-5 working days. TDV8/SDV8 jobs may take slightly longer due to the V8 configuration.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on timing chain repairs?
items.a: Yes. Every timing chain repair includes a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty covering parts and labour.

items.q: What is included in a Land Rover timing chain kit?
items.a: A timing chain kit includes new timing chains, tensioners, guide rails, sprockets where worn, and all necessary gaskets and seals. The TDV6/SDV6 kit also includes the timing belt that drives the exhaust camshafts.

items.q: What are the symptoms of a failing timing chain on a Land Rover diesel?
items.a: Common symptoms include a rattling noise on start-up, a check engine warning light with timing-related codes, rough running, and in some cases, engine stalling or failure to start.
